blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — The National Bureau of Investigation (NBI) said Thursday it is preparing to file six complaints against individuals allegedly involved in dumping pet remains, which were supposedly intended for cremation, inside sacks and plastic bags at a vacant lot in San Jose del Monte, Bulacan. NBI Director Melvin Matibag made the statement after announcing that two individuals who identified themselves as operators of Pet HPHT Crematory in San Jose del Monte voluntarily appeared before the agency to submit their sworn statements.
